fnthinkReceiveDesc.zh: 开启后才会从服务器收取消息；关闭后既不发送也不接收
fnthinkReceiveDesc.en: Messages are fetched from the server only while this is on; when it is off, neither sending nor receiving occurs.

fnthinkReceiveDisabled.zh: 接收功能未开启，本次操作未执行
fnthinkReceiveDisabled.en: Receiving is disabled; this action was not performed.

fnthinkReceiveSkipped.zh: 上一轮尚未结束，本轮结果将在其结束后显示
fnthinkReceiveSkipped.en: The previous round is still in progress; this round's result will appear after it finishes.

fnthinkPresenceAsleep.zh: 当前未自动运行（开关已关闭，或尚未同意中转）
fnthinkPresenceAsleep.en: Not running automatically right now (the switch is off, or relay consent has not been granted).

fnthinkPresenceDead.zh: 自动恢复链已中断：本机不再自动唤醒（开关与同意均仍开启）
fnthinkPresenceDead.en: The automatic recovery chain is broken: this device will no longer wake on its own (the switch and consent are still enabled).

fnthinkPresenceLive.zh: 后台常驻收取中（长轮询，有消息时立即返回）
fnthinkPresenceLive.en: Persistent background fetching (long polling; returns immediately when a message is available).

fnthinkPresenceLiveNoLock.zh: 后台常驻收取中（长轮询，但系统未授予唤醒锁）
fnthinkPresenceLiveNoLock.en: Persistent background fetching (long polling, but the system did not grant a wake lock).

fnthinkPresencePendingFirstRound.zh: 尚未安排首轮收取（刚启动，首轮完成后将自动安排后续轮次）
fnthinkPresencePendingFirstRound.en: The first round has not been scheduled yet (just started; later rounds are scheduled automatically after the first round completes).

fnthinkPresenceBackoff.zh: 限流退避中：约 {minutes} 分 {seconds} 秒后自动重试（本次为一次性退避，非常规间隔）
fnthinkPresenceBackoff.en: Rate-limit backoff: automatic retry in about {minutes} min {seconds} s (a one-off backoff, not the regular interval).

fnthinkPresenceNext.zh: 下次自动唤醒：{time}（每 {seconds} 秒）

fnthinkPresenceNextNoCadence.zh: 下次自动唤醒：{time}（间隔未知）

fnthinkPresenceStreamHealthy.zh: 实时唤醒已连接 · 兜底间隔 {seconds} 秒

fnthinkPersistQueuedWarning.zh: 本机仍有 {count} 条幻念消息尚未写入收件表，每轮收取开始前将再次尝试写入
fnthinkPersistQueuedWarning.en: {count} Fnthink message(s) are still held locally and have not been written to the inbox; they will be retried before each fetch round starts.

fnthinkPersistAbandonedWarning.zh: 有 {count} 条幻念消息已停止重试（存放超过 24 小时或已尝试 20 次），不会再自动写入收件表
fnthinkPersistAbandonedWarning.en: {count} Fnthink message(s) have stopped being retried (held for over 24 hours or attempted 20 times) and will no longer be written to the inbox automatically.

fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestFailed.zh: 测试通知未能发出（请先检查系统通知权限）
fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestFailed.en: The test notification could not be sent (check the system notification permission first).

fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestSent.zh: 测试通知已发出，请查看锁屏以确认响铃与振动
fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestSent.en: Test notification sent. Check the lock screen to confirm sound and vibration.

fnthinkInboxSelfCheckRebuilt.zh: 已切换至新的高优先级渠道：{id}
fnthinkInboxSelfCheckRebuilt.en: Switched to a new high-priority channel: {id}

fnthinkInboxIssueChannelMissing.zh: 收件渠道尚未创建（首次收件时将自动创建）
fnthinkInboxIssueChannelMissing.en: Inbox channel not created yet (it will be created automatically on the first message).

fnthinkInboxIssueNoSound.en: No sound is configured for the channel.

fnthinkInboxIssueNotHigh.zh: 渠道已被系统降级（不再显示横幅）
fnthinkInboxIssueNotHigh.en: The channel has been downgraded by the system (heads-up banners are no longer shown).

fnthinkInboxIssueLockscreen.en: Not shown on the lock screen

fnthinkConsentPending.zh: 尚未同意中转：经服务器的收发均已停止
fnthinkConsentPending.en: Relay consent has not been granted; all server-relayed sending and receiving are stopped.

fnthinkConsentNotGranted.zh: 本机尚未同意内容经服务器中转，本次操作未执行
fnthinkConsentNotGranted.en: This device has not consented to relaying content through the server; this action was not performed.

fnthinkConsentRevokeDone.zh: 已撤销：经服务器的收发与远程控制均不可用，配置与历史记录未删除。
fnthinkConsentRevokeDone.en: Revoked: server-relayed sending and receiving, and remote control, are unavailable. No configuration or history was deleted.

fnthinkChannelDisclosureShort.zh: 是否响铃、振动或显示横幅，由系统侧的通知渠道决定
fnthinkChannelDisclosureShort.en: Whether a push sounds, vibrates, or shows a banner is determined by the system-side notification channel.

fnthinkChannelDisclosure.zh: 收到的推送是否响铃、振动或显示横幅，由系统通知设置中的「幻念推送 · 收件」渠道决定。本机已按最高档创建该渠道：重要性为紧急（显示横幅）、声音为系统默认通知音、振动已开启。部分厂商系统（如小米）在该层之上另有按应用管理的悬浮窗与锁屏开关，需在系统设置中核对。
fnthinkChannelDisclosure.en: Whether an incoming push sounds, vibrates, or displays a banner is determined by the "Fnthink Push · Inbox" notification channel in system notification settings. This device creates the channel at the top tier: importance = urgent (heads-up banner), sound = system default notification tone, vibration = on. Some vendor systems (e.g. Xiaomi) provide additional per-app floating-window and lock-screen switches above this layer; these must be checked in system settings.

fnthinkWorkChain.zh: 后台任务：收取 {presenceWork} · 转发 {fanoutWork} · 待发 {queue} 条

fnthinkHealthNever.zh: 协议面未知：暂无协议请求读数
fnthinkHealthNever.en: Protocol plane unknown: no protocol request readings yet

fnthinkDiagWorkerNever.zh: 上次后台轮次：暂无记录
fnthinkDiagWorkerNever.en: Last background round: none recorded yet

fnthinkDiagAlarmNever.zh: 上次闹钟触发：暂无记录
fnthinkDiagAlarmNever.en: Last alarm fired: none recorded yet

fnthinkDiagStreamNever.zh: 上次 SSE 字节：暂无记录
fnthinkDiagStreamNever.en: Last SSE byte: none recorded yet

fnthinkLastRoundNever.zh: 上次成功收取：暂无记录
fnthinkLastRoundNever.en: Last successful fetch: none recorded yet

fnthinkScreenKeepalive.zh: 锁屏持续接收（耗电增加）
fnthinkScreenKeepalive.en: Keep receiving while locked (increases battery use)

fnthinkScreenKeepaliveDesc.zh: 锁屏后仍保持 CPU 唤醒，可更及时收取消息；耗电会明显增加。
fnthinkScreenKeepaliveDesc.en: Keeps the CPU awake while the screen is off so messages arrive sooner; battery use increases noticeably.

fnthinkExactAlarmMissing.zh: 精确闹钟未授权：后台收取可能延迟。
fnthinkExactAlarmMissing.en: Exact alarms not granted: background fetches may be delayed.

fnthinkPairingPeersHint.zh: 对端需要以下两项：本机地址码与本次一次性口令
fnthinkPairingPeersHint.en: The other device needs these two items: this device's address code and this one-time pairing code.

fnthinkPairApprovedOneWayShort.zh: 双向发送已开通，逐项权限仍需对端自行勾选
fnthinkPairApprovedOneWayShort.en: Both directions can send now; per-item permissions still require the other device to select them.

fnthinkPairApprovedOneWay.zh: 两台设备现已可互相发送通知：本次确认写入了两段授权，分别保存在被投设备的名单中。尚未完成的是逐项权限：L2 动作与 L3 设置需由对端在其同意界面上自行勾选，本机无法代为操作。
fnthinkPairApprovedOneWay.en: The two devices can now send notifications to each other. This confirmation wrote two grants, each stored on the receiving device's list. What remains is the per-item permission set: L2 actions and L3 settings must be selected by the other device on its own consent screen; this device cannot do so on its behalf.

fnthinkPairRequestsSent.en: Pairing requests sent by this device

fnthinkPairRefresh.zh: 向服务器查询对端答复
fnthinkPairRefresh.en: Check the server for the other device's response

fnthinkPairRefreshQuiet.zh: 已向服务器查询，对端暂无新结论
fnthinkPairRefreshQuiet.en: The server has been queried; the other device has no new response yet.

fnthinkPairRequestLine.zh: {peer} 请求与本机配对，请求档位为 {level} · {at}
fnthinkPairRequestLine.en: {peer} requests pairing with this device, requesting {level} · {at}

fnthinkPairWillGrant.zh: 本机本次最多可授予 {level}；更高档位需在本机确认
fnthinkPairWillGrant.en: This device can grant at most {level} this time; any higher level must be confirmed on this device.

fnthinkPairUnknownLevel.zh: 对端所报档位「{level}」不在本机档位表中，无法同意，仅可拒绝
fnthinkPairUnknownLevel.en: The level "{level}" reported by the other device is not in this device's level table; it cannot be approved and can only be denied.

fnthinkPairApproveOutbound.zh: 同意时同时将其设为外发目标
fnthinkPairApproveOutbound.en: Also set it as an outbound target when approving

fnthinkPairApproveOutboundDesc.zh: 勾选后，本机将立即完成两项：勾选名单项，并创建一条目标为该设备的通道。
fnthinkPairApproveOutboundDesc.en: When checked, this device completes both local steps immediately: the roster entry is selected and a channel targeting it is created.

fnthinkSenderDisplayLabel.zh: 收件中发送人的显示方式
fnthinkSenderDisplayLabel.en: How the sender is shown in the inbox

fnthinkPeersError.zh: 无法读取名单（{reason}）；显示失败并不表示没有已配对设备
fnthinkPeersError.en: The list could not be read ({reason}); an unreadable view does not mean there are no paired devices.

fnthinkPeersEmpty.en: No devices have been paired yet

fnthinkPeerLine.zh: 对端 → 本机 · 已授予 {level} · {at}

fnthinkPeerForwardToggle.zh: 本机 → 对端 · 可接收本机转发的通知
fnthinkPeerForwardToggle.en: This device → peer · may receive notifications forwarded by this device

fnthinkPeerForwardChannelMade.zh: 已为对端创建通道，三项条件均已具备
fnthinkPeerForwardChannelMade.en: Created a channel to the peer; all three conditions are now in place.

fnthinkPeerForwardChannelKept.zh: 已存在通往该对端的通道，未重复创建
fnthinkPeerForwardChannelKept.en: A channel to the peer already exists; no duplicate was created.

fnthinkPeerForwardHint.zh: 勾选后，本机收到的通知才会转发至该对端。
fnthinkPeerForwardHint.en: Check this so notifications received by this device are forwarded to the peer.

fnthinkPairLinkRejectedShort.en: This device cannot use this link

fnthinkPairLinkRejected.zh: 本机无法使用此链接：该链接不是幻念推送配对链接，或协议版本不匹配。请回到该设备重新生成配对口令后再试
fnthinkPairLinkRejected.en: This device cannot use this link: it is not a Fnthink pairing link, or the protocol version does not match. Return to that device, generate a new pairing code, and try again.

fnthinkPairPeerPendingNoteShort.zh: 提交后仅在对端新增一条待确认请求
fnthinkPairPeerPendingNoteShort.en: Submitting only adds a pending request on the other device

fnthinkPairPeerPendingNote.zh: 提交后仅在对端新增一条待确认请求：是否同意由对端决定，本机名单中的对应行将在下一轮收取后出现。
fnthinkPairPeerPendingNote.en: Submitting only adds a pending request on the other device: it decides whether to approve, and the corresponding row in this device's list appears after the next receive round.

fnthinkPeersBoundaryShort.zh: 此处记录本机已同意的设备
fnthinkPeersBoundaryShort.en: This section records devices this device has approved

fnthinkPeersBoundary.zh: 此处记录本机已同意的设备。撤销时先由服务器收回授权，本机对应行随后消失；已收到的通知不会被删除。对端授予本机的许可，需由对端自行撤销。
fnthinkPeersBoundary.en: This section records devices this device has approved. Revoking first has the server withdraw the grant; the corresponding row here then disappears, and notifications already received are not deleted. The grant the other device gave this device must be revoked by that device.

fnthinkPairAskMsg.zh: 将 {peer} 加入本机名单并授予 {level}。同意后，该设备可向本机推送消息。
fnthinkPairAskMsg.en: Adds {peer} to this device's list and grants {level}. After approval, that device can push notifications to this device.

fnthinkPairNoGrantedLevel.zh: 服务端已接受，但未返回记录的档位，本机名单未写入
fnthinkPairNoGrantedLevel.en: The server accepted it but did not return the recorded level; nothing was written to the local list.

fnthinkPeerStoreUnavailable.zh: 服务端已接受，但本机未接入名单存储，名单未写入
fnthinkPeerStoreUnavailable.en: The server accepted it but no peer store is connected on this device; nothing was written.

fnthinkPeerWriteFailed.zh: 服务端已接受，但本机写入名单失败，名单未写入
fnthinkPeerWriteFailed.en: The server accepted it but writing the local list failed; nothing was written.

fnthinkPairKeySwapped.zh: {peer} 的地址码上次使用另一把公钥，本机未作任何修改。该设备可能已重建身份，也可能有人冒用该地址码
fnthinkPairKeySwapped.en: {peer} presented a different public key for this address code; nothing was changed. The device may have rebuilt its identity, or someone may be spoofing the code.

fnthinkPairApproved.zh: 已同意 {peer}，服务端记录档位为 {level}

fnthinkRevokeAskMsg.zh: 撤销后，{peer} 将无法再向本机推送；已收到的通知保留。此次仅终止该方向，本机授予对端的推送权限不受影响（需在对端自行撤销）。此操作需由服务器收回授权，离线时无法完成。
fnthinkRevokeAskMsg.en: After revoking, {peer} can no longer push to this device; notifications already received are kept. This only ends that direction; this device's grant to push to it is unaffected (it must be revoked on the other device). The server must withdraw the grant, so this cannot be completed offline.

fnthinkPeerRenameTitle.zh: 为该设备设置名称（仅本机可见）
fnthinkPeerRenameTitle.en: Name this peer (visible only on this device)

fnthinkPeerRenameGone.en: This peer is no longer in the list

fnthinkRevokeFailed.zh: 撤销失败（{reason}）；名单中该行仍保留，反映当前实际状态
fnthinkRevokeFailed.en: Revoking failed ({reason}); the row remains in the list, reflecting the current state.

fnthinkRevokeStoreUnavailable.zh: 服务器已撤销，但本机未接入名单删除功能，该行仍保留
fnthinkRevokeStoreUnavailable.en: The server revoked it, but row deletion is not connected on this device; the row remains.

fnthinkRevokeRowRemains.zh: 服务器已撤销，但本机删除该行失败，该行仍保留
fnthinkRevokeRowRemains.en: The server revoked it, but deleting this row failed; the row remains.

fnthinkRevokeAlreadyGone.zh: 服务器已不存在 {peer} 的授权（撤销具有幂等性，目标已达成）
fnthinkRevokeAlreadyGone.en: The server no longer holds a grant for {peer} (revocation is idempotent; the goal is already met).

fnthinkRevoked.zh: 已撤销 {peer}：该设备此后无法向本机推送
fnthinkRevoked.en: Revoked {peer}: that device can no longer push to this device.

remoteSendLevelUnknown.zh: 档位（{level}）不在协议词表中，无法发送。
remoteSendLevelUnknown.en: This level ({level}) is not in the protocol vocabulary; nothing will be sent.

remoteSendNeedsReportCount.zh: 回传条数必须为 {min}–{max} 之间的整数。
remoteSendNeedsReportCount.en: The number to return must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.

remoteSendNeedsShortcutName.zh: 名称长度须为 {min}–{max} 个字符，且不得包含控制字符。
remoteSendNeedsShortcutName.en: The name must be {min}–{max} characters and contain no control characters.

remoteSendNeedsCallsKeyword.zh: 关键词长度须为 {min}–{max} 个字符，且不得包含控制字符。
remoteSendNeedsCallsKeyword.en: The keyword must be {min}–{max} characters and contain no control characters.

remoteSendNeedsContactsKeyword.zh: 姓名或号码长度须为 {min}–{max} 个字符，且不得包含控制字符。
remoteSendNeedsContactsKeyword.en: The name or number must be {min}–{max} characters and contain no control characters.

remoteSendNeedsSmsKeyword.zh: 关键词长度须为 {min}–{max} 个字符，且不得包含控制字符。
remoteSendNeedsSmsKeyword.en: The keyword must be {min}–{max} characters and contain no control characters.

remoteSendNeedsArgument.zh: 此项需要参数（目标通道标识），为空时无法发送。
remoteSendNeedsArgument.en: This item requires an argument (the target channel id); it cannot be sent empty.

remoteSendNeedsWant.zh: 尚未选择目标开关状态；仅指定「切换」而不指定目标状态时，重复投递会恢复原状。
remoteSendNeedsWant.en: No target state selected. Specifying only "toggle" without the desired state means a redelivery will revert it.

remoteSendNeedsCredential.zh: 本档必须携带高级密钥或二步验证码之一；两项均为空时无法发送。
remoteSendNeedsCredential.en: This level must carry either an advanced key or a two-step code; with both empty, nothing can be sent.

fnthinkSendTierNote.zh: 两档为同一条出站请求的两种载荷；是否执行由对端判定。
fnthinkSendTierNote.en: Both tiers are two payload forms of the same outbound request; whether it runs is decided by the other device.

remoteSendCancelNote.zh: 取消后不会发送任何数据；本次输入中的凭据也不会带出。
remoteSendCancelNote.en: Cancel sends no data; the credential entered here will not leave this device.

remoteSendStartedNote.zh: 已发出。请等待对端返回「正在执行」与「执行完毕」两条回执，它们将显示在远程执行历史中。
remoteSendStartedNote.en: Sent. Wait for the other device to return two receipts, "executing" and "execution_done"; they will appear in the remote execution history.

remoteSendFailed.en: This send did not go out: {reason}

fnthinkSendNoticeVsCommandShort.zh: 通知：让对端查看内容；指令：让对端执行动作
fnthinkSendNoticeVsCommandShort.en: Notice: show content on the other device; command: make it perform an action

fnthinkSendNoticeVsCommand.zh: 「一条通知」是让对端查看一段内容（无需任何授权，也不执行动作）；「一条远程指令」是让对端执行一个动作（需要配对关系与档位授权，最高档位还需通过延时确认）。
fnthinkSendNoticeVsCommand.en: "A notice" lets the other device see some content (no grant is required and no action is performed); "a remote command" asks it to perform an action (it requires the pairing and a level grant, and the top level also passes the delayed-confirm window).

fnthinkContractUnavailable.zh: 无法读取随包协议契约，本页暂时无法修改任何设置：{reason}
fnthinkContractUnavailable.en: The bundled protocol contract cannot be read, so nothing on this page can be changed yet: {reason}

remotePeersReadFailedShort.zh: 无法读取名单，并不表示尚未配对设备
remotePeersReadFailedShort.en: The peer list could not be read; this does not mean no devices are paired

remotePeersReadFailed.zh: 无法读取名单（未能读取数据库中该表）。这不表示「尚未配对设备」，请先查看「设备配对」页。
remotePeersReadFailed.en: The peer list could not be read (the table was not returned). This does not mean "no paired devices"; check the Device pairing page first.

fnthinkSendTargetNoPeer.zh: 本机尚未配对任何设备，请先在「设备配对」页完成配对，或在下方选择一条 Webhook 通道。
fnthinkSendTargetNoPeer.en: No device is paired yet. Pair one on the "Device pairing" page, or select a Webhook channel below.

fnthinkSendTargetWebhookOnlyForNoticeSho.zh: 指令仅发送至已配对设备
fnthinkSendTargetWebhookOnlyForNoticeSho.en: Commands go only to paired devices

fnthinkSendTargetWebhookOnlyForNotice.zh: 远程指令只能发送至已配对设备；Webhook 通道没有配对关系，也没有档位授权。如需发送至通道，请切换回「一条通知」。
fnthinkSendTargetWebhookOnlyForNotice.en: Remote commands can only be sent to paired devices; a Webhook channel has no pairing relationship and no level grant. To send to a channel, switch back to "A notice".

fnthinkSendTargetWebhookEmptyShort.zh: 尚无已启用的 Webhook 通道

fnthinkSendTargetWebhookEmpty.zh: 尚无已启用的 Webhook 通道，请在「幻念通道」页创建一条（填写接入端点的推送地址并保持启用）。
fnthinkSendTargetWebhookEmpty.en: No enabled Webhook channel. Create one on the "Fnthink channels" page (enter the endpoint push URL and keep it enabled).

fnthinkSendBoundary.zh: 「发送一条」走设备签名通道，只能发送至名单中的设备；发送成功不等同于送达，仅当该设备实际显示并返回回执后，方可视为送达。
fnthinkSendBoundary.en: Send goes through the signed device path and can only go to a device on the list; a successful send is not proof of delivery — only when that device displays it and returns an ack is it delivered.

fnthinkSendEnvelopeHelpTitle.en: The title travels inside the body envelope

fnthinkSendEnvelopeNote.zh: 设备通道的标题随正文信封传输：签名数据中没有独立标题字段，仅端点两种形态具备该字段。收件人看到的标题来自这段正文。
fnthinkSendEnvelopeNote.en: On the device path, the title travels inside the body envelope: the signed bytes have no separate title field, only the two endpoint forms do. The title the recipient sees comes from this body.

fnthinkSendEmptyBody.zh: 正文为空时不发送，对端只会收到空内容
fnthinkSendEmptyBody.en: No body, no send — the other device would only receive an empty message

remoteSendLevelL2.zh: 中风险：仅允许经幻念推送，凭据可选
remoteSendLevelL2.en: Medium risk: push only; a credential is optional

remoteSendLevelL3.zh: 高风险：必须经幻念推送，且必须携带密钥或二步验证码
remoteSendLevelL3.en: High risk: push only, and it must carry a key or a two-step code

remoteSendReportCountWhyShort.zh: 仅回传这段文字，不涉及读取权限
remoteSendReportCountWhyShort.en: Only this text is returned; no read access

remoteSendReportCountWhy.zh: 仅回传以下文字：时间、应用、标题与正文。对端收到的是一条消息，而非设备的读取权限。
remoteSendReportCountWhy.en: Only this text is returned: time, app, title and body. The other device receives a message, not read access to a device.

remoteSendShortcutNameWhy.zh: 填写对端在本机登记过的名称（本机无法查看该清单）。名称不匹配时，本次指令不会执行。
remoteSendShortcutNameWhy.en: Enter a name registered on the other device (this device cannot see that list). If the name does not match, this command will not run.

remoteSendCallsKeywordWhy.zh: 仅回传命中的记录（时间／方向／对方／时长）。对端「可被远程读取的内容」中该项关闭时，本次指令不会执行。
remoteSendCallsKeywordWhy.en: Only matching entries are returned (time / direction / party / duration). If that item is disabled under the other device's "Readable remotely", this command will not run.

remoteSendContactsKeywordWhy.zh: 仅回传命中的记录（姓名／号码）。对端「可被远程读取的内容」中该项关闭时，本次指令不会执行。
remoteSendContactsKeywordWhy.en: Only matching entries are returned (name / number). If that item is disabled under the other device's "Readable remotely", this command will not run.

remoteSendSmsKeywordWhy.zh: 仅回传命中的消息（时间／号码／正文）。对端的短信监听关闭时，本次指令不会执行。
remoteSendSmsKeywordWhy.en: Only matching messages are returned (time / number / body). If SMS monitoring is disabled on the other device, this command will not run.

remoteSendChannelIdWhyShort.zh: 此项需手动填写：本机无法查看对端通道
remoteSendChannelIdWhyShort.en: Enter this field manually: this device cannot list the other device's channels

remoteSendChannelIdWhy.zh: 仅此项需手动填写：本机无法查看对端已配置的通道（需协议支持列表查询）。族与开关目标均在下方选择，并按对端可识别的格式拼接。
remoteSendChannelIdWhy.en: This is the only field you enter manually: this device cannot see which channels the other device has configured (listing them requires protocol support). The family and on/off target are selected below and assembled into a format the other device recognizes.

fnthinkSendSent.zh: 已提交服务端排队（{id}）。送达状态以该设备的回执为准。
fnthinkSendSent.en: Queued on the server ({id}). Delivery is proven only by that device's ack.

fnthinkSendRejectedUnsigned.zh: 签名无法识别：本机身份与服务端记录不一致（可能需要重新配对）
fnthinkSendRejectedUnsigned.en: Signature not recognized: this device's identity does not match on the server (re-pairing may be required)

fnthinkSendRejectedCapability.zh: 对端未授予本档权限，或双方尚未配对
fnthinkSendRejectedCapability.en: The other device did not grant this level, or the two devices are not paired yet

fnthinkSendReplayed.zh: 触发去重窗口：请稍后重新发送，以免重复触发
fnthinkSendReplayed.en: De-duplication window hit: wait a moment before sending again to avoid duplicate dispatch

fnthinkSendNeedsCalibration.zh: 时间未校准：请先执行一次「立即收取」，再发送
fnthinkSendNeedsCalibration.en: Clock not calibrated: run Receive now once, then send

fnthinkSendRateLimited.zh: 本分钟发送次数过多，请在 {seconds} 秒后重试
fnthinkSendRateLimited.en: Too many sends this minute; try again in {seconds} seconds

fnthinkSendTransportError.zh: 无法连接服务端，本次消息未发送
fnthinkSendTransportError.en: The server could not be reached; this message was not sent

fnthinkSendSigningUnavailable.zh: 本机签名不可用：请在上方重置凭据三件套，或重新配对
fnthinkSendSigningUnavailable.en: This device cannot sign: reset the credential triple above, or pair again

fnthinkSendBadInput.zh: 正文包含无法发送的字符，本次消息未发送
fnthinkSendBadInput.en: The body contains a character that cannot be sent; this message was not sent

fnthinkSendUnparseable.zh: 服务端已接收但未返回编号，无法追踪本次消息
fnthinkSendUnparseable.en: The server accepted it but returned no id, so this message cannot be tracked

fnthinkSendEvicted.zh: 另有 {count} 条消息因超出每设备上限被移除。
fnthinkSendEvicted.en: {count} older message(s) were dropped to stay under the per-device cap.

fnthinkEndpointRevokeAskMsg.zh: 关闭「{id}」后，持有该口令的调用方将立即被拒绝。口令无法找回：服务端仅保存摘要，如需继续使用须重新创建。
fnthinkEndpointRevokeAskMsg.en: After {id} is closed, callers holding that token are refused immediately. The token cannot be recovered: the server stores only a digest, so continuing to use it requires creating a new endpoint.

fnthinkEndpointRevokeFailed.zh: 此端点未能关闭（{reason}）；它仍在接收，列表显示服务端记录。
fnthinkEndpointRevokeFailed.en: This endpoint was not closed ({reason}); it still accepts pushes, and the list shows the server's copy.

fnthinkEndpointRevokeAlreadyGone.zh: 「{id}」此前已停止接收；本次操作已达到目标，并非失败。
fnthinkEndpointRevokeAlreadyGone.en: {id} had already stopped accepting pushes; this operation met the goal and is not a failure.

fnthinkEndpointRevoked.zh: 已关闭「{id}」：该端点不再接收。记录仍保留，列表中可看到其已停止。
fnthinkEndpointRevoked.en: Closed {id}: that endpoint no longer accepts pushes. The record remains, and the list shows it stopped.

fnthinkEndpointRotateAskMsg.zh: 轮换后将生成一个新口令，仅显示一次。旧口令可使用至宽限期结束（下方会显示具体时间），此后持有旧口令的调用方将被拒绝。
fnthinkEndpointRotateAskMsg.en: Rotating generates a new token, shown only once. The old token remains valid until the grace period ends (the time is shown below); after that, callers holding the old token are refused.

fnthinkEndpointRotateNotRotated.zh: 「{id}」已停止接收，因此未轮换口令；轮换不会恢复该端点，如需继续使用请重新创建。
fnthinkEndpointRotateNotRotated.en: {id} has stopped accepting pushes, so its token was not rotated; rotation does not restore the endpoint. Create a new one to continue using it.

fnthinkEndpointRotated.zh: 已轮换「{id}」的口令；新口令仅在上方显示一次。
fnthinkEndpointRotated.en: Rotated the token for {id}; the new token is shown above only once.

fnthinkEndpointTitle.zh: 接入端点（供 NAS / 脚本使用）

fnthinkEndpointLastUsedUnknown.en: Not reported (the other device's build is older)

fnthinkEndpointWhyShort.zh: 接入端点：供第三方平台向本机推送通知
fnthinkEndpointWhyShort.en: Ingress endpoints: how third parties push notifications to this device

fnthinkEndpointWhy.zh: 第三方平台向本机推送通知所用的长期口令。服务端仅保存摘要；下方口令仅在本次显示，离开页面后无法再次查看。
fnthinkEndpointWhy.en: Long-lived tokens that third-party platforms use to push notifications to this device. The server stores only a digest; the token below is shown only this time and cannot be seen again after leaving the page.

fnthinkEndpointCap.zh: 本机最多可创建 {max} 个端点；达到上限后仅拒绝新建，不会挤占正在使用的端点。
fnthinkEndpointCap.en: This device can create up to {max} endpoints; at the cap, new endpoints are refused and endpoints in use are not displaced.

fnthinkEndpointCountOf.zh: 本机已有 {n} 个端点（上限 {max}）。

fnthinkEndpointOnce.zh: 此口令仅显示一次，请立即复制；此后只能重新创建端点（旧口令无法找回）。
fnthinkEndpointOnce.en: This token is shown only once; copy it now. Afterwards you can only create a new endpoint (the old token cannot be recovered).

fnthinkEndpointFailed.zh: 端点创建失败（{reason}）；服务端未返回口令，因此不存在「已创建但无法复制」的状态。
fnthinkEndpointFailed.en: Endpoint creation failed ({reason}); no token was returned, so there is no "created but uncopiable" state.

fnthinkEndpointListRead.zh: 查询本机已创建的端点
fnthinkEndpointListRead.en: Query endpoints created on this device

fnthinkEndpointListPendingShort.zh: 尚未查询本机端点数量
fnthinkEndpointListPendingShort.en: Endpoint count on this device has not been queried yet

fnthinkEndpointListPending.zh: 尚未查询本机端点数量。「没有」与「尚未查询」含义不同，因此此处不列出任何内容，也不表示没有端点。
fnthinkEndpointListPending.en: The number of endpoints on this device has not been queried. "None" and "not yet queried" are different statements, so nothing is listed here and no claim of none is made.

fnthinkEndpointListFailed.zh: 本次查询失败（{reason}）；「查询失败」不等于「没有」，因此此处仍不列出任何内容，也不表示没有端点。
fnthinkEndpointListFailed.en: This query failed ({reason}); "query failed" is not "none", so nothing is listed here and no claim of none is made.

fnthinkEndpointNone.zh: 查询完成：本机名下没有接入端点。如需使用，请点击上方按钮创建。
fnthinkEndpointNone.en: Query completed: this device has no ingress endpoints. Use the button above to create one if needed.

fnthinkEndpointNotUsable.zh: 已停止接收（服务端记录状态为「{status}」）
fnthinkEndpointNotUsable.en: No longer accepting pushes (the server records the status as "{status}")

fnthinkEndpointRotateGrace.en: The old token remains valid until {until}.

fnthinkEndpointGetWarning.zh: GET 形态仅用于展示结构：口令位于 URL 路径段，会进入反向代理访问日志。在本站日志脱敏配置完成前，此方式不提供可整行复制的真实口令；如需立即使用，请采用上方的 POST 方式。
fnthinkEndpointGetWarning.en: The GET form is shown as a shape only: it puts the token in the URL path, so it does land in the reverse proxy's access log. Until log redaction is configured on this server, this branch gives no copyable real token — use the POST above if you need it working now.

fnthinkEndpointPushUrlWhy.zh: 仅需粘贴到其他软件的单个 Webhook 输入框时，此方式将口令放在 URL 最后一段，直接 POST 即可，无需请求头。⚠ 口令进入 URL 后会进入反向代理访问日志；在本站日志脱敏配置完成前，能够发送请求头的客户端应优先使用上方的 Bearer 方式。
fnthinkEndpointPushUrlWhy.en: When you only need to paste into another app's single Webhook field, this form carries the token in the last path segment, so a plain POST is enough — no request headers required. ⚠ A token in the URL does land in the reverse proxy's access log. Until log redaction is configured on this server, prefer the Bearer form above whenever your client can send headers.

fnthinkEndpointCopyHint.zh: 「一键复制」仅在创建（或轮换）后的一段时间内可用：口令只保存在当前页面内存中，离开后返回将无法再填入；如需再次复制，只能轮换口令。
fnthinkEndpointCopyHint.en: One-tap copy works only for a while right after you create (or rotate) one: the token lives just in this page's memory, and once you leave the page it can no longer be filled in — rotate to copy again.

remoteCredKeyResetAsk.zh: 移除后，对端持有的旧密钥将立即失效；须重新生成并当面交付。
remoteCredKeyResetAsk.en: Once removed, the other side's copy stops working immediately; generate a new one and hand it over in person.

remoteCredResetAllAsk.zh: 全部重置后，对端持有的高级密钥与验证码种子将立即失效。如需继续远程执行，须重新生成并当面交付。
remoteCredResetAllAsk.en: After a full reset, both the advanced key and the code seed held by the other side stop working immediately. To continue remote execution, generate new ones and hand them over in person.

remoteExecLocalTriggerShort.zh: 使选中应用通知正文中的指令在本机执行
remoteExecLocalTriggerShort.en: Run commands contained in notifications from selected apps on this device

remoteExecLocalTriggerWhyTitle.zh: 本机通知触发机制说明
remoteExecLocalTriggerWhyTitle.en: How the local notification trigger works

remoteExecLocalTriggerWhy.zh: 此路径不携带凭据：它读取通知栏正文，因此任何能向自身通知写入文本的应用都可能成为指令来源。开启后，来自下方所选应用且命中白名单关键词的通知，若正文以指令信封开头，将在本机执行（仅限 L1）。默认关闭；关闭不影响已配对设备经幻念推送发来的指令。⚠ 此处「可触发的应用」与「需转发的应用」是两份独立清单：前者决定哪些应用的通知可操作本机，后者决定哪些应用的通知需要转发。
remoteExecLocalTriggerWhy.en: This path carries no credential: it reads the body of a notification, so any app that can write text into its own notification is a potential command source. While enabled, a notification from one of the selected apps below that matches a whitelist keyword and starts with the command envelope will run on this device (L1 only). Off by default; disabling it does not affect commands from paired devices over Fnthink Push. Note that the trigger app list and the forwarding list are separate: one decides whose notifications may act on this device, the other decides whose notifications are forwarded.

remoteExecLocalTriggerOn.zh: 已开启：仍仅限所选应用且命中关键词的通知才可能触发
remoteExecLocalTriggerOn.en: On: only notifications from selected apps with a keyword hit can trigger

remoteExecLocalTriggerOff.zh: 已关闭：任何通知正文均不会被执行
remoteExecLocalTriggerOff.en: Off: no notification body will be executed

remoteExecLocalTriggerBlockCount.zh: 除 {count} 个应用外均可触发

remoteExecLocalTriggerAllowNone.zh: 允许 0 个应用，任何通知均不会触发
remoteExecLocalTriggerAllowNone.en: 0 apps allowed; no notification can trigger anything

remoteExecShort.zh: 他方可让本机执行操作；默认关闭，升级不会自动开启。
remoteExecShort.en: Others can make this device act. Off by default — an upgrade will not turn it on for you.

remoteExecWhyTitle.zh: 远程执行的安全边界由什么决定
remoteExecWhyTitle.en: What decides the safety boundary of remote execution

remoteExecWhy.zh: 他方可让本机执行操作。安全边界由两项决定：指令来自哪条渠道，以及是否携带凭据。开关默认关闭，升级不会替用户作出该决定。
remoteExecWhy.en: Others can make this device act. Safety depends on two things: the channel the command arrives on, and whether a credential comes with it. The switch is off by default — an upgrade never makes that decision for you.

remoteExecNeedsCredential.zh: 已开启但未设置任何凭据，高风险（L3）指令将无法进入。
remoteExecNeedsCredential.en: On but no credential is set; no high-risk (L3) command can get in.

remoteExecDelayUsingDefault.zh: 本条将在 {seconds} 秒后自动执行（协议默认值）
remoteExecDelayUsingDefault.en: This runs automatically {seconds}s later (the protocol default)

remoteExecDelayChosen.zh: 本条将在 {seconds} 秒后自动执行（自定义值）

remoteExecDelayRange.zh: 可设范围 {min}–{max} 秒，由协议规定，并非本机偏好
remoteExecDelayRange.en: Allowed range {min}–{max}s, set by the protocol, not a local preference

remoteExecDelayInvalid.en: The delay setting is not in effect: {reason}

remoteCredShort.zh: 此密钥用于授权他方让本机执行操作，与「证明本机身份」所用的密钥不同。
remoteCredShort.en: This key authorizes others to make this device act; it is not the key that proves this device's identity.

remoteCredWhyTitle.zh: 凭据与设备身份为何是两把不同的密钥
remoteCredWhyTitle.en: Why the credential and the device identity are two different keys

remoteCredWhy.zh: 凭据用于授权某一条远程指令，与设备身份是两把不同的密钥：一把证明本机身份，另一把授权他方让本机执行操作。
remoteCredWhy.en: A credential authorizes a remote command and is different from the device identity key: one proves this device's identity, the other authorizes someone to make it act.

remoteCredKeySetNoFingerprint.zh: 已设置（本机无其指纹，无法辨别具体密钥）
remoteCredKeySetNoFingerprint.en: Set (this device has no fingerprint for it and cannot identify which key it is)

remoteCredKeyOnceShort.zh: 此密钥串仅显示一次，请立即保存
remoteCredKeyOnceShort.en: Shown once only; save it now

remoteCredKeyOnce.zh: 此密钥串仅显示一次：请立即保存至仅有你可访问的位置，或当面交付对端设备。关闭本页后，本机仅保留哈希，任何人（包括你本人）都无法再次读取该密钥串。
remoteCredKeyOnce.en: This key string is shown only once: save it now somewhere only you can access, or hand it to the other device in person. After this page is closed, only the hash remains on this device; nobody, including you, can read the string again.

remoteCredTotpLink.zh: 添加至验证器 App 的链接
remoteCredTotpLink.en: Link to add to the authenticator app

remoteCredTotpSecret.zh: 密钥串（也可在验证器 App 中手动输入）
remoteCredTotpSecret.en: Secret string (can also be entered manually in the authenticator app)

remoteCredTotpOnceShort.zh: 此验证码种子仅显示一次，请立即录入对端验证器
remoteCredTotpOnceShort.en: This code seed is shown only once; enroll it in the other device's authenticator now

remoteCredTotpOnce.zh: 此验证码种子仅显示一次，且仅存在于接收端：请立即录入对端设备的验证器 App，或当面交付对方录入。此后由验证器保管，不经过任何服务器；本机关闭本页后仅保留该种子。
remoteCredTotpOnce.en: This code seed is shown only once and exists only on the receiving device: enter it into the other device's authenticator app now, or hand it over in person to be entered there. Afterwards the authenticator holds it and no server sees it; once this page is closed, only the seed remains on this device.

fnthinkResetCodeMsg.zh: 本机地址码将在所有对端白名单中立即失效，原有配对关系全部失效，需重新配对。
fnthinkResetCodeMsg.en: This device's address code will stop working in every peer's allowlist immediately. All existing pairings become invalid and must be redone.

fnthinkHostDesc.zh: 仅填写主机名（可含端口）；scheme 由协议确定，无需填写 https://
fnthinkHostDesc.en: Host name only (port allowed); the scheme is determined by the protocol, so https:// is not needed

fnthinkHostNoCandidates.zh: 协议契约未声明可选的服务地址
fnthinkHostNoCandidates.en: The protocol contract declares no selectable server address

fnthinkSelfCheckPresenceOk.zh: 对端状态读取接口正常
fnthinkSelfCheckPresenceOk.en: Peer status read endpoint is healthy

fnthinkSelfCheckHealthUnknown.zh: 服务可达；协议契约版本不可读

fnthinkProtocolNever.zh: 未知 · 暂无协议请求读数
fnthinkProtocolNever.en: Unknown · no protocol request reading available yet

fnthinkProtocolUnverified.zh: 未验证 · 服务有响应，但尚无成功的协议请求
fnthinkProtocolUnverified.en: Unverified · the service responds, but no protocol request has succeeded

fnthinkContractVersionMismatch.zh: 服务器上的协议版本较旧，部分消息将无法发送
fnthinkContractVersionMismatch.en: The server runs an older protocol version; some messages cannot be sent

fnthinkContractVersionUnreadable.zh: 无法判断服务器协议版本是否为最新
fnthinkContractVersionUnreadable.en: Cannot determine whether the server's protocol version is current

fnthinkHostUpdateNote.zh: 检查更新使用独立链路，不随此处切换。
fnthinkHostUpdateNote.en: Update checks use a separate route and do not follow this setting.

channelSelfCheckConfirmTitle.zh: 四个通道族各发送一条测试消息？
channelSelfCheckConfirmTitle.en: Send one test message to each of the four channel families?

channelSelfCheckConfirmBody.zh: 将从每个通道族中选取一条通道，实际发送一条最小测试消息；幻念仅执行探针，不投递，不占用额度。自检不写入推送历史，也不改变主备状态。
channelSelfCheckConfirmBody.en: One channel from each family will actually send a minimal test message. The fnthink family only runs a non-invasive probe: nothing is delivered and no quota is used. The check writes no push history and does not change primary/backup state.

channelSelfCheckNoChannelLine.zh: {family} — 此通道族无已启用通道
channelSelfCheckNoChannelLine.en: {family} — no enabled channel in this family

backupModeBanner.zh: 当前正通过备用通道推送：主通道连续不可用时会自动降级，连续 {n} 次探测成功后自动恢复主通道；也可随时手动切回。
backupModeBanner.en: Pushing via backup channels: the app falls back automatically when primary channels stay unavailable, and returns to primary after {n} consecutive successful probes. You can also switch back at any time.

channelFailureHelpTitle.zh: 如何解读最近一次失败
channelFailureHelpTitle.en: How to read the last failure

channelFailureHelpBody.zh:
此行仅为取证记录，不代表当前判定：即使通道后来恢复，该记录仍会保留。

网络未连通 —— 请求未到达对端（断网、DNS 解析失败或连接超时）。
服务器返回错误 —— 对端返回 4xx 或 5xx，具体状态码见送达记录。
平台限流 —— 对端要求降低发送频率（429），系统将自动等待后重试。
平台业务拒绝 —— HTTP 连接正常，但平台判定内容不合规（errcode 非 0），重试无效。
本机中断 —— 消息尚未发出即被本机终止（推送已暂停或引擎未运行）。
无法归类 —— 存在 HTTP 状态码，但为 2xx 或 3xx，且无业务拒绝迹象；系统不作推测。

连续 N 次 —— 截至本次失败，向前连续失败的条数；中间出现一次成功即重新计数。
channelFailureHelpBody.en:
This line is evidence only, not a current verdict: it remains even after the channel recovers.

Network unreachable — the request never reached the other side (no connection, DNS failure, or timeout).
Server returned an error — the other side returned 4xx or 5xx; the exact status code is in the delivery log.
Rate limited — the platform requested a lower sending rate (429); the system waits and retries automatically.
Rejected by the platform — HTTP succeeded, but the platform judged the content non-compliant (non-zero errcode); retrying will not help.
Stopped on this device — the message was stopped here before sending (push paused or engine not running).
Unclassified — an HTTP status code exists, but it is 2xx or 3xx with no sign of a business rejection; the system does not guess.

N in a row — the number of consecutive failures ending at this one; a success in between resets the count.

channelStatusShort.zh: 此处列出所有已启用通道，以及各通道最近一次探测的结果与地址。
channelStatusShort.en: Every enabled channel with its latest probe result and address.

channelStatusGuide.zh: 此处列出所有已启用通道，以及各通道最近一次探测的结果与地址。点击任意条目可直接进入其配置页。
channelStatusGuide.en: Every enabled channel with its latest probe result and address. Tap any row to open that channel's settings.

mainBackupRecommend.zh: 主通道建议不超过 5 条；超出后仍可保存，但通道数量越多，并发发送与失败判定越慢。
mainBackupRecommend.en: Keep primary channels at 5 or fewer. More are allowed, but fan-out and failure detection get slower as channels increase.

mainBackupUnsetNotice.zh: 「未设置」是新增通道的初始状态：不会随主通道重复推送，仅在未设置任何主通道时使用。将常用通道设为「主」更为准确。
mainBackupUnsetNotice.en: "Unset" is the initial state of a newly added channel: it never duplicates a primary send and is used only when no channel is marked Primary. Marking your everyday channel as "Primary" is more precise.

mainBackupExcluded.zh: 标记为「不参与」的通道保留配置但不推送，可随时重新启用。

privacyInfoContent.zh:
本应用遵循“最小必要”原则，仅收集实现核心功能所必需的信息：

1. 通知内容（本地处理）
   - 应用通过系统通知监听服务读取通知内容
   - 通知内容在设备本地完成规则匹配与关键词过滤，仅按您自行配置的目标转发：Webhook、邮件地址或幻念设备
   - 除您指定的上述目标外，通知内容不会上传至任何其他服务器；其中「幻念设备」路径经您选定的中转服务器投递，详见第 7 项

2. 崩溃统计信息（腾讯 Bugly，默认关闭）
   - 仅在您于「更多 → 崩溃上报」主动开启后，才收集应用崩溃时的堆栈信息、设备型号、系统版本、应用版本号、CPU 架构
   - 未开启时 SDK 不初始化，数据不离开设备；开启后仅用于定位和修复崩溃问题，提升应用稳定性

3. 推送统计与历史记录（本地存储）
   - 通知记录、推送状态、每日统计等数据使用 AES-256 加密存储在本地数据库
   - 这些数据仅保存在您的设备上，不会对外发送

4. 延迟推送队列（本地存储）
   - 规则约束产生的延迟/定时推送任务持久化保存在本机，重启后不丢失

5. 电池状态（本地监控）
   - 电量及充电状态监控仅在本机采集，用于首页展示，不对外发送

6. 已安装应用列表（本地使用）
   - 用于规则约束的条件配置与应用过滤，仅在本机使用

7. 幻念推送（设备互推 / 第三方经接入端点推给手机，需您显式同意）
   - 仅在您使用「幻念推送」并在应用内一次性显式同意后，消息才会经您选定的服务器中转送达目标设备；不使用或不同意时，通知内容始终不离开本机
   - 未送达期间，消息正文在服务器端加密暂存，最长保留 7 天，送达或到期后立即删除
   - 配对口令与身份私钥不上传，服务器与审计日志只保存投递所需的元数据（不含正文）
   - 若您选择自行部署幻念推送服务器，上述中转与保留规则由您自己的服务器执行，数据处于您掌控的基础设施内
   - 远程读取（默认关、单独开启）：您在「可被远程读取的内容」中为某一项单独开启开关并授予系统权限后，已配对设备方可经同一条中转链路读回该项数据（例如按关键词检索到的通话记录、最近一次定位、让这台拍的一张照片、按姓名或号码检索到的联系人）；关闭后即失效
   - 拍照回传：照片文件保存在拍摄设备上（Android 10 及以上保存至相册，9 及以下保存至本应用图片目录）；图像随回传消息经您选定的服务器中转发回发起设备，并保存在双方的消息历史中。该项与其他远程读取项一样默认关闭、单独开启，关闭后不再执行
   - 「搜索短信」还可检索本机已监听的留存内容（默认关闭）：该留存保存的是监听短信时写入本机数据库的正文，此开关仅决定对端能否检索；关闭时仅查询系统短信库
   - ⚠ 若您选择的实例属于别人运营的实例：该服务器使用其自身密钥进行落盘加密，「服务器不落明文正文」描述的是存储形态，并不等于运营方无法读取；投递元数据与运维日志亦由其掌握。这与配置 Webhook 转发目标属于同一类决定，请仅连接您信得过的实例
privacyInfoContent.en:
This App follows the principle of "minimum necessary" and only collects information required for core functionality:

1. Notification Content (Local Processing)
   - The app reads notification content through the system notification listener service
   - Notification content is matched against rules and filtered by keywords on-device, then forwarded only to the targets you configure: a Webhook, an email address, or an Fnthink device
   - Apart from those targets you specify, notification content is never uploaded to any other server; the Fnthink device route is delivered through a relay server you choose - see section 7

2. Crash Statistics (Tencent Bugly, off by default)
   - Collected only after you explicitly enable "Crash Reporting" under More → settings
   - The SDK is not initialized and no data leaves the device until enabled; used solely to locate and fix crash issues and improve app stability

3. Push Statistics & History (Local Storage)
   - Notification records, delivery status, and daily statistics are AES-256 encrypted and stored in a local database
   - These data stay on your device and are never transmitted externally

4. Delayed Push Queue (Local Storage)
   - Delay/scheduled push tasks from the rule constraints are persisted locally and survive reboots

5. Battery Status (Local Monitoring)
   - Battery level and charging status are monitored locally for the home page display only

6. Installed App List (Local Use)
   - Used for rule constraint condition configuration and app filtering, on-device only

7. Fnthink Push (device-to-device, or a third party pushing to your phone via an endpoint — requires your explicit consent)
   - Only after you use Fnthink Push and give a one-time, explicit in-app consent are messages relayed through the server you choose to reach the target device; if you do not use it or do not consent, notification content never leaves this device
   - While undelivered, the message body is encrypted and stored on the server for at most 7 days, then deleted immediately upon delivery or expiry
   - Pairing codes and the identity private key are never uploaded; the server and audit logs keep only the metadata needed for delivery (no message bodies)
   - If you self-host the Fnthink Push server, the above relay and retention rules are enforced by your own server, and the data stays within infrastructure you control
   - Remote reading (off by default, one item at a time): only after you turn on a switch under "Readable remotely" for that item and grant the system permission can a paired device read that item back through the same relay (e.g. the call-log entries matching a keyword, the last known location, a photo taken on this device, or the contacts matching a name or number); turning the switch off takes effect immediately
   - Photo capture: the photo file stays on the device that took it (the gallery on Android 10+, the app's pictures directory on 9 and below); the image is relayed with the reply message through the server you choose to the device that asked for it, and is stored in both sides' message history. Like the other remote reads, it is off by default and enabled one item at a time; turning it off stops it immediately
   - Searching SMS may also include the retention this device already holds (off by default): that store holds the bodies the SMS listener put into the local database, and this switch only decides whether a peer may search it; off, only the system SMS database is queried
   - ⚠ If the instance is run by someone else: that server encrypts stored bodies with its own key, so 'no plaintext body on the server' describes the storage form, not what its operator can read — delivery metadata and operations logs are in their hands too. This is the same kind of decision as configuring a webhook target: only connect to instances you trust

privacyPermContent.zh:
本应用遵循最小权限原则，以下为完整权限清单及用途说明：

核心权限（必需）：
• 通知使用权（Notification Listener）：读取通知内容，实现转发与规则约束功能
• 网络访问（INTERNET）：Webhook/邮件推送与版本更新检查
• 前台服务（FOREGROUND_SERVICE 等）：保持通知监听服务常驻，确保消息及时推送
• 开机自启动（RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED）：设备重启后自动恢复通知监听服务
• 通知发送（POST_NOTIFICATIONS）：发送本地通知提示
• 唤醒锁（WAKE_LOCK）：延迟/定时推送到点唤醒设备

辅助权限（可选）：
• 电量优化白名单（REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS）：避免系统限制后台服务
• 短信（RECEIVE_SMS/READ_SMS）：可选，用于短信通知识别与转发
• 本机短信留存（通知监听写入数据库的部分）：无需额外系统权限；仅在「可被远程读取的内容」中开启此项后，允许已配对设备按关键词检索该留存（关闭时不会查询该留存）
• 电话状态（READ_PHONE_STATE）：可选，用于来电通知识别
• 通话记录（READ_CALL_LOG）：可选，仅在「可被远程读取的内容」中开启并授权后，允许已配对设备按关键词检索本机通话记录
• 位置（ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION）：可选，仅在「可被远程读取的内容」中开启并授权后，允许已配对设备读取本机最近一次定位（只读，不发起新的定位）
• 相机（CAMERA）：可选，仅在「可被远程读取的内容」中开启并授权后，允许已配对设备让本机拍一张照片（照片文件保存在本机，图像随回传消息经服务器中转发回发起设备，双方消息历史各保存一份；且要求本应用界面处于开启状态）
• 通讯录（READ_CONTACTS）：可选，仅在「可被远程读取的内容」中开启并授权后，允许已配对设备按姓名或号码检索本机通讯录（只读，不写入）
• 存储（READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE）：导出推送历史 JSON、保存更新 APK
• 安装未知应用（REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES）：应用内在线更新时安装 APK
• 查询已安装应用（QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES）：规则约束的条件配置与应用过滤
• 振动（VIBRATE）：推送提示振动
• 网络状态（ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE）：检测网络连接状态

以上辅助权限均在您主动授权后使用，可随时在系统设置中关闭。
privacyPermContent.en:
This App follows the principle of least privilege. The complete permission list and purposes are as follows:

Core Permissions (Required):
• Notification Listener: Read notification content for forwarding and the rule constraints
• Internet (INTERNET): Webhook/email push and update checks
• Foreground Service (FOREGROUND_SERVICE, etc.): Keeps the notification listener alive for timely delivery
• Boot Completed (RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED): Automatically restores the listener after reboot
• Post Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS): Sends local notification prompts
• Wake Lock (WAKE_LOCK): Wakes the device for delayed/scheduled pushes

Auxiliary Permissions (Optional):
• Battery Optimization Whitelist (REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS): Prevents the system from restricting background services
• SMS (RECEIVE_SMS/READ_SMS): Optional, for SMS notification recognition and forwarding
• SMS retained on this device (the copy the notification listener stored): needs no extra system permission; only after you turn this switch on under "Readable remotely" may a paired device search that store by keyword (off means that store is never queried)
• Phone State (READ_PHONE_STATE): Optional, for incoming call notification recognition
• Call Log (READ_CALL_LOG): Optional; only after you enable it under "Readable remotely" and grant it may paired devices search this device's call log by keyword
• Location (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION): Optional; only after you enable it under "Readable remotely" and grant it may a paired device read this device’s last known location (read-only; no new fix is started)
• Camera (CAMERA): Optional; only after you enable it under "Readable remotely" and grant it may a paired device take one photo on this device (the photo file stays on this device, and the image is relayed with the reply message through the server to the device that asked for it, stored in both sides' message history; the app must be open on screen)
• Contacts (READ_CONTACTS): Optional; only after you enable it under "Readable remotely" and grant it may a paired device search this device’s contacts by name or number (read-only)
• Storage (READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE): Export push history JSON and save update APKs
• Install Unknown Apps (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES): Installs APKs for in-app updates
• Query All Packages (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES): Rule constraint condition configuration and app filtering
• Vibrate (VIBRATE): Vibration for push prompts
• Network State (ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE): Detects network connectivity

Auxiliary permissions are only used after your explicit authorization and can be revoked anytime in system settings.

fnthinkChannelProbeOk.zh: 已发送（{ms} 毫秒），徽标记录的就是本次结果。
fnthinkChannelProbeOk.en: Sent ({ms} ms); this is what the badge records.

fnthinkChannelProbeRejected.zh: 对端未接受此消息（无报错，但状态不是 accepted）。
fnthinkChannelProbeRejected.en: The other side did not accept it (no error, but the status is not accepted).

fnthinkChannelTargetNotChecked.zh: 此设备尚未勾选为转发目标
fnthinkChannelTargetNotChecked.en: This device is not checked as a forwarding target

fnthinkChannelTargetBadScheme.zh: Webhook 目标必须以 https:// 开头
fnthinkChannelTargetBadScheme.en: A webhook target must start with https://

fnthinkChannelTargetPick.zh: 从名单中选择一台设备
fnthinkChannelTargetPick.en: Pick a device from the list

fnthinkChannelNoTargetPicked.zh: 尚未勾选任何设备，请先前往「设备配对」勾选一台。
fnthinkChannelNoTargetPicked.en: No device is checked yet; check one under Device pairing first.

fnthinkChannelProbeWhy.zh: 将实际向对端发送一条消息（此通道族无不打扰对端的探针），对端会收到该消息。

fnthinkChannelProbeUnavailable.en: A webhook target cannot be probed from this page (its sender lives on the native side), so this only saves.

fnthinkShortcutsNameInvalid.zh: 名称须为 1–32 个字符，且不得包含控制字符。
fnthinkShortcutsNameInvalid.en: The name must be 1-32 characters with no control characters.

fnthinkShortcutsTargetInvalid.zh: 目标须为带 scheme 的链接，或「包名/类名」。
fnthinkShortcutsTargetInvalid.en: The target must be a link with a scheme, or "package/class".

fnthinkShortcutsNameLabel.zh: 名称（对端按此名称调用）
fnthinkShortcutsNameLabel.en: Name (the other side calls it by this)

fnthinkShortcutsDeleteAsk.zh: 删除「{name}」后，对端再次按此名称调用将无法打开。是否继续？
fnthinkShortcutsDeleteAsk.en: After deleting "{name}", the other side can no longer open it by that name. Continue?

fnthinkShortcutsWhyShort.zh: 对端仅可打开您在此登记的入口
fnthinkShortcutsWhyShort.en: The other side can only open entries you registered here

fnthinkShortcutsWhy.zh: 对端仅可打开您在此登记的入口：填写名称，再填写用于打开它的目标——该应用自身公开的链接，或本机的「包名/类名」。
fnthinkShortcutsWhy.en: The other side can only open entries you register here: give a name, then the target that opens it - a link the app itself publishes, or this device's "package/class".

fnthinkShortcutsEmpty.zh: 尚未登记任何入口：缺少入口时，对端的「打开某个入口」操作将无法匹配名称，不会执行任何动作。
fnthinkShortcutsEmpty.en: No entries registered yet - without one, the other side's "open an entry" action has no name to match and does nothing.

remotePeersReadFailedShort.zh: 无法读取名单，并不表示尚未配对设备
remotePeersReadFailedShort.en: The peer list could not be read; this does not mean no devices are paired

databaseRecoveryBody.zh: 重建前保留的旧数据库备份：{time}，{size}。恢复将使用此备份覆盖当前数据库；当前数据库会先另行保存，不会被直接删除。
databaseRecoveryBody.en: A backup from before the rebuild was found: {time}, {size}. Restoring replaces the current database with this backup; the current database is saved aside first, not deleted.

databaseRecoveryDone.zh: 已从旧数据库备份恢复，正在刷新页面数据。
databaseRecoveryDone.en: Restored from the old backup. Refreshing page data.

databaseRecoveryFailed.zh: 旧数据库备份未通过完整性校验，未进行任何覆盖：{reason}
databaseRecoveryFailed.en: The old backup failed the integrity check; nothing was overwritten: {reason}

databaseMigrationBackupBody.zh: 升级前已自动备份旧数据库：{time}，{size}。可恢复此备份（当前数据库会先另行保存），或重试本次升级。
databaseMigrationBackupBody.en: A pre-upgrade copy was saved automatically: {time}, {size}. You can restore it (the current database is saved aside first) or retry the upgrade.

secureStorageUnavailableBody.zh: 加密数据库的密钥已失效（无法读取 Android Keystore 主密钥），「重试」无法恢复。请前往系统设置 → 应用 → 通知推送助手 → 存储 → 清除应用数据，然后重新打开；历史记录与配对信息将一并丢失，本应用不会代为执行此操作。
secureStorageUnavailableBody.en: The encryption key can no longer be decrypted (the Android Keystore master key failed), and Retry cannot fix it. Go to system settings → Apps → Notification Push Assistant → Storage → Clear data, then reopen. History and pairings will be erased; the app will not do that for you.

databaseUnavailableBody.zh: 加密数据库无法打开；原文件已保留，历史记录未被清空。请点击「重试」再次打开。
databaseUnavailableBody.en: The encrypted database could not be opened. Your data was kept; tap Retry to try again.

serviceRunning.en: Notification service is running; tap to stop it

servicePausedWhileListening.zh: 当前仍读取设备通知，但推送已暂停；点击可恢复推送
servicePausedWhileListening.en: Still reading this device's notifications, but pushing is paused. Tap to resume.

serviceStoppedCallSmsOnly.zh: 通知转发已停止，仅转发电话与短信
serviceStoppedCallSmsOnly.en: Notifications are off; only calls and SMS are forwarded

serviceStopped.zh: 通知监听服务未启动，点击可启动服务
serviceStopped.en: Notification service is stopped; tap to start it

callSmsForwardingDesc.en: Keep forwarding calls and SMS while listening is off

smsMonitorDesc.zh: 控制是否监听并推送收到的短信
smsMonitorDesc.en: Control whether received SMS are monitored and pushed

notificationEngineShort.zh: 电量、温度等设备自身状态达到条件时提醒；是否转发在「更多 → 筛选与规则」中配置。

notificationEngineScopeTitle.en: What this page covers, and what it does not

notificationEngineDesc.zh: 设备自身状态达到条件时提醒：电量、温度。已到达的通知是否转发，在「更多 → 筛选与规则」中配置。
notificationEngineDesc.en: Alerts the device raises about itself: battery and temperature. Whether an incoming notification gets forwarded is set under More → Filter & Rules.

fnthinkHubDesc.zh: 发送去向：设备绑定、发起推送与接收设置均位于此区域。
fnthinkHubDesc.en: Where to send: paired devices, sending a notice and receiving settings live here.

fnthinkHubReceiveDesc.zh: 接收消息、轮询间隔，以及对端可让本机执行的操作（远程执行），均在此处配置。
fnthinkHubReceiveDesc.en: Receiving, the polling interval, and what the sender may make this device do (remote execution) live here.

fnthinkHubSendDesc.zh: 发送至已配对设备，或发送至 Webhook 通道；与「远程指令」不属于同一层级
fnthinkHubSendDesc.en: Send to a paired device, or to a Webhook channel; not the same tier as a remote command

fnthinkHubChannelsDesc.zh: 本机作为发送方时的转发目标。
fnthinkHubChannelsDesc.en: Where this device forwards to as a sender.

fnthinkEndpointEntryDesc.zh: 供 NAS、脚本、监控等外部服务接入的长期口令。多数用户无需修改此项。
fnthinkEndpointEntryDesc.en: A long-lived token that lets external services — a NAS, scripts, monitoring — push in. Most people never need to touch this.

fnthinkHubSettingsDesc.zh: 本机身份信息（地址码、配对口令、身份密钥），以及所连接的服务器。
fnthinkHubSettingsDesc.en: Who this device is (address code, pairing passphrase, identity key) and which server it talks to.

engineConstraintEntry.zh: 设备状态告警同样受约束
engineConstraintEntry.en: Apply keyword constraints to device alerts

engineConstraintShort.zh: 开启后，电量/温度告警在推送前同样经过关键词黑白名单过滤。
engineConstraintShort.en: When on, battery and temperature alerts also pass the keyword allow/block lists before being pushed.

engineConstraintTitle.zh: 设备状态告警受哪些约束，以及被拦截后的处理
engineConstraintTitle.en: Which constraints apply to device-state alerts, and what happens when one is blocked

engineConstraintDesc.zh: 开启后，电量/温度告警在推送前同样经过关键词黑白名单过滤；应用黑白名单不适用（此类告警由本机自身产生）。被拦截的告警将写入推送历史并标注原因。

fnthinkHubPeersDesc.zh: 显示已配对设备数量，可向设备发送消息，也可撤销指定设备。
fnthinkHubPeersDesc.en: Which devices are paired, send one to them, or revoke one of them.

fnthinkHubPeersOutgoing.en: {n} still waiting for the other device

fnthinkRemoteNeedsConsent.en: Not consented yet - read the note on the Receive page and agree

fnthinkRemoteNeedsSwitch.en: Remote execution is off by default - open it here

batchSelectAll.zh: 全选可重新发送的记录

ruleDescriptionHint.zh: 可选；用于描述规则用途

ruleEmptyConditions.zh: 暂无条件，点击即可添加
ruleEmptyConditions.en: No conditions yet. Tap to add one

ruleEmptyActions.zh: 暂无动作，点击即可添加
ruleEmptyActions.en: No actions yet. Tap to add one

ruleAppScopeDesc.zh: 被排除的应用不再匹配本规则
ruleAppScopeDesc.en: Excluded apps do not match this rule

mergeMaxItemsHint.en: Push as soon as this many items arrive; 0 or blank waits for the window (optional)

appListPermMsg.zh:

点击「允许」后将跳转至系统设置页，请手动授予权限。
appListPermMsg.en:
This permission is used to read the installed app list, which enables notification filtering by app.

Tap "Allow" to open system settings and grant it manually.

notifToggleDesc.zh: 开启后，以下提醒方可生效
notifToggleDesc.en: Reminders below only work when this is enabled

batteryNotes3.zh: 电量通知随通知监听服务一同运行
batteryNotes3.en: Battery notifications run together with the notification listener service

batteryNotes4.zh: 点击规则可编辑；左滑或长按可删除
batteryNotes4.en: Tap a rule to edit it; swipe or long-press to delete

batteryOptDesc.zh: 息屏后系统会限制后台运行，可能导致通知监听服务中断
batteryOptDesc.en: After the screen turns off, the system may restrict background activity and interrupt the notification listener service

ruleStartCharging.zh: 设备接入充电器时推送
ruleStartCharging.en: Push when the charger is connected

ruleStopCharging.zh: 设备断开充电器时推送
ruleStopCharging.en: Push when the charger is disconnected

customTitleHint.en: Leave empty to use the default title

autostartGuideTitle.zh: 自启动需在厂商设置中开启
autostartGuideTitle.en: Auto-start Is Enabled in Your Vendor Settings

autostartGuideMsg.zh:
自启动不属于 Android 的标准权限，各厂商将其置于自家的管家类应用内，系统没有统一开关，应用内亦无法申请。

点「去开启」将跳转至本机对应的设置页，请将本应用设为「允许自启动」；设置完成后返回应用即可生效。
autostartGuideMsg.en:
Auto-start is not a standard Android permission: each vendor keeps it in its own manager app. There is no unified switch, and apps cannot request it.

“Open settings” jumps to the page your device provides: set this app to “allow auto-start”; it takes effect when you return to the app.

appListPermUnknown.zh: 该系统版本不提供明确状态，以能否读取应用列表为准
appListPermUnknown.en: This system version reports no explicit state; access is determined by whether the app list can actually be read

appListPermGuideTitle.zh: 应用列表权限需由系统放行
appListPermGuideTitle.en: App-List Access Must Be Granted by the System

appListPermGuideMsg.zh:
系统里这一项名为「读取已安装的应用列表」（部分机型位于「权限」页，部分位于「其他权限」或「应用权限」中）。

点「去开启」将跳转至本应用的系统设置页，请找到该项并允许；设置完成后返回应用即可生效。
appListPermGuideMsg.en:
The system calls this “Read installed apps” (some ROMs place it under Permissions, others under Other permissions or App permissions).

“Open settings” takes you to this app’s system page: find that item and allow it; it takes effect when you return to the app.

pushDeviceInfoShort.zh: 将上述快照作为一条通知推送至已启用的通道。
pushDeviceInfoShort.en: Sends this snapshot to your enabled channels as one notification.

pushDeviceInfoDesc.zh: 将上述快照作为一条通知推送至已启用的通道；该通知与告警使用同一条推送链，送达结果可在推送历史中查看。
pushDeviceInfoDesc.en: Sends this snapshot to your enabled channels as one notification. It uses the same delivery chain as alerts, so delivery results appear in push history.

ruleGuideAddDesc.zh: 点击右上角「+」或右下角浮动按钮以创建新规则
ruleGuideAddDesc.en: Tap "+" in the top bar or the floating button to create a new rule

ruleGuideConditionDesc.zh: 配置规则的触发条件（IF），例如应用包名、关键词、时间等
ruleGuideConditionDesc.en: Configure the IF conditions (app package, keyword, time, etc.)

ruleGuideActionDesc.zh: 设置条件满足后执行的动作（THEN），例如推送通知、静默忽略等
ruleGuideActionDesc.en: Configure the THEN actions (push notification, silent ignore, etc.)

noDeviceStateRules.zh: 暂无设备状态规则，点击右上角 + 添加
noDeviceStateRules.en: No device state rules yet. Tap + to add one

deviceStateDesc.zh: 屏幕亮度与网络状态的变化同样可以触发提醒。仅在「跨越」阈值的那一刻计为一次事件（持续低于阈值不会重复提醒）；触发后 30 分钟内同一类别不再重复提醒。
deviceStateDesc.en: Changes in screen brightness and network state can also trigger alerts. Only the moment a threshold is crossed counts as an event (staying below it does not re-alert); the same category will not alert again within 30 minutes.

deviceStateNotes2.zh: 亮度按百分比判定；网络类触发仅关注「断网」与「联网」两种事件，无需阈值。
deviceStateNotes2.en: Brightness is judged by percentage; network rules only react to "disconnected" and "reconnected" and need no threshold.

appFilterBlockModeInfo.zh: 当前模式：不通知应用；未选择任何应用时，全部应用的通知均会推送
appFilterBlockModeInfo.en: Mode: Block; with none selected, all app notifications are pushed

appFilterAllowModeInfo.zh: 当前模式：通知应用；未选择任何应用时，全部应用的通知均会推送（默认）
appFilterAllowModeInfo.en: Mode: Allow; with none selected, all app notifications are pushed (default)

updateServerEntryDesc.zh: 选择检查更新所使用的服务器（大陆或海外）
updateServerEntryDesc.en: Choose which server update checks use (mainland or overseas)

backupRestoreSubtitle.zh: 加密备份通道、规则与设置，并支持换机恢复
backupRestoreSubtitle.en: Encrypted backup of channels, rules and settings, restorable on a new device

remoteTriggerBlockModeInfo.zh: 当前模式：禁止触发；除已选应用外，其余应用的通知均可触发
remoteTriggerBlockModeInfo.en: Mode: Block; except for selected apps, notifications from other apps can trigger

remoteTriggerAllowModeInfo.zh: 当前模式：允许触发；仅已选应用的通知正文可触发本机远程指令
remoteTriggerAllowModeInfo.en: Mode: Allow; only the notification content of selected apps can trigger remote commands on this device

remoteHistoryCancelNote.zh: 取消仅对尚未开始执行的记录有效；已开始执行的记录不受此窗口影响。
remoteHistoryCancelNote.en: Cancelling only applies before execution starts; a record already running is past this window.

remoteHistoryRemoved.zh: 此条已从本机历史中删除。
remoteHistoryRemoved.en: This entry has been removed from this device's history.

remoteHistoryBoundaryShort.zh: 本页仅记录本机这一份
remoteHistoryBoundaryShort.en: This page records only this device's own copy

remoteHistoryBoundary.zh: 远程执行历史仅记录本机这一份：收到的与发出的指令均予记录。凭据与指令正文不进入本层，而是随该消息的密文正文传递；回执与留痕各自保存。
remoteHistoryBoundary.en: This history records only this device's own copy: both received and sent commands. Credentials and command text never enter this layer; they travel inside that message's encrypted body, while receipts and audit rows each keep their own copy.

remoteHistoryLocalTrigger.zh: 由本机应用通知触发（无远端发送方）
remoteHistoryLocalTrigger.en: Triggered by this device's own app notification (no remote sender)

mergeMaxItemsLabel.zh: 达到 N 条时提前推送

ruleDelaySecondsHint.zh: 例如 60 表示延迟 1 分钟

webhookDesc1.zh: 支持同时配置多个 Webhook 通道，每个通道均可独立开关
webhookDesc1.en: Multiple Webhook channels can be configured at once, each with its own switch

webhookDesc3.en: Newly added channels are enabled by default

simFilterRemindMsg.zh: 受小米等系统限制，部分短信无法识别所属 SIM 卡（通知栏兜底链路）。此类短信不受本设置影响，仍会照常推送。
simFilterRemindMsg.en: Due to system limitations (e.g. Xiaomi/HyperOS), some SMS cannot be attributed to a SIM card (notification fallback path). Such SMS are unaffected by this setting and will still be pushed.

smsMonitorTotalDesc.zh: 关闭后将不再监听或推送任何短信
smsMonitorTotalDesc.en: When off, no SMS will be monitored or pushed

codeMonitorDesc.zh: 关闭后，包含验证码的短信将不再推送
codeMonitorDesc.en: When off, SMS containing verification codes will not be pushed

simFilterSingleSim.zh: 当前设备仅检测到一张 SIM 卡，无需选择
simFilterSingleSim.en: Only one SIM detected on this device; no selection needed

simFilterDesc.zh: 同时作用于短信与电话
simFilterDesc.en: Applies to both SMS and calls

fnthinkReadEntryShort.zh: 对端可读取本机的哪些内容；每一项默认关闭，需单独开启。
fnthinkReadEntryShort.en: What the other side can read from this device; each item is off by default and enabled separately.

deleteKeywordConfirm.zh: 确定删除关键词「{keyword}」吗？删除后将不再参与过滤。
deleteKeywordConfirm.en: Delete keyword "{keyword}"? It will stop taking part in filtering.

keywordWhitelistDesc.zh: 白名单：通知内容包含任一关键词时，即使应用未被选中也将推送（优先级最高）
keywordWhitelistDesc.en: Whitelist: a notification containing any keyword is pushed even if the app is not selected (highest priority)

keywordBlacklistDesc.zh: 黑名单：通知内容包含任一关键词时，即使应用已被选中，也将不予推送
keywordBlacklistDesc.en: Blacklist: a notification containing any keyword will not be pushed even if the app is selected

webhookChannelNameHint.zh: 可选，例如 企业微信·通知

webhookHeadersHint.zh: 每行一个，格式为 Name: Value，例如 X-Api-Key: xxx
webhookHeadersHint.en: One per line as Name: Value, e.g. X-Api-Key: xxx

feishuMarkdownDowngradeHint.zh: 飞书自定义机器人不支持 markdown，将降级为纯文本发送（markdown 符号将原样显示）。建议使用 text 格式。
feishuMarkdownDowngradeHint.en: Feishu custom bots do not support markdown. Messages are sent as plain text (markdown symbols shown as-is). Consider using text format.

webhookTemplateHint.zh: 留空时使用预置模板；支持的变量：
webhookTemplateHint.en: Leave empty to use the preset; supported variables:

updateServerShort.zh: 检查更新与下载安装包所使用的服务器由本页决定，不影响幻念推送的服务地址。
updateServerShort.en: This page decides which server checks and downloads updates. It does not change the Fnthink Push service address.

updateServerHelpTitle.zh: 两种模式的含义与选择方式
updateServerHelpTitle.en: What the two options mean and how to choose

updateServerHelpBody.zh: 软件在两台服务器上发布更新：大陆服务器为 notice.fnthink.com，海外服务器为 notice.fnthink.top；除域名后缀与 CDN 主机名外，两台的链接逐字一致。首次进入时按网络实测时延选择一台；此后每次打开本页都会分别探测两台。也可切换为手动模式固定某一台，固定后不会自动更改。「自动」表示跟随最近一次实测结果：若不打开本页，仍沿用上次测得的那一台。安装包的实际下载地址由所选服务器自行下发；两台的版本信息分别维护，可能短暂不一致。此时本页会分别列出两台报告的最新版本，供用户判断应切换至哪一台。
updateServerHelpBody.en: Updates are published on two servers: notice.fnthink.com for mainland China and notice.fnthink.top for overseas users. Except for the domain suffix and CDN host name, the links are identical. On first entry, one server is selected based on measured network latency; afterwards, both are probed each time this page is opened. You may also switch to manual mode to pin one server, which then remains fixed. “Automatic” means following the most recent measurement: if this page is not opened, the previously measured server remains in use. The actual installer download address is issued by the selected server; version information is maintained separately on each server and may be briefly inconsistent. In that case this page lists the latest version reported by each server so you can decide which one to switch to.

updateServerAutoUnprobed.zh: 自动模式尚无实测结果：当前使用默认服务器。
updateServerAutoUnprobed.en: Automatic mode has no measurement yet: the default server is in use.

updateServerBothDown.zh: 两台服务器均探测失败：暂时使用默认服务器，可稍后重新探测，或手动指定一台。
updateServerBothDown.en: Neither server answered: the default server is in use for now. Probe again later, or pin one manually.

updateServerNoAnswer.zh: 无响应（网络或域名解析失败）

updateServerAnswerEmpty.zh: 连接成功，但该服务器未返回版本信息
updateServerAnswerEmpty.en: Connected, but the server returned no version information

updateServerLatestLine.zh: 该服务器报告的最新版本：{version}+{build}

updateServerCdnMismatch.zh: 注意：安装包实际来自 {actual}，与本档约定的 {expected} 不一致
updateServerCdnMismatch.en: Note: the installer actually comes from {actual}, not the expected {expected} for this region

backupSectionShort.zh: 将全部设置打包为一个文件，换机或重装后可一键恢复。
backupSectionShort.en: Pack all settings into a single file so they can be restored in one step after switching phones or reinstalling.

backupSectionDesc.zh:
将全部设置打包为一个文件，换机或重装后可一键恢复。

包含：Webhook 与邮件通道（含密钥）、通知规则、短信监听开关、应用筛选与黑白名单关键词。
不含：已推送的通知历史。

文件受密码保护，恢复时需输入同一密码，请务必牢记。
backupSectionDesc.en:
Pack all settings into a single file so they can be restored in one step after switching phones or reinstalling.

Includes: Webhook and email channels (with credentials), notification rules, the SMS monitoring switch, app filters and keyword lists.
Excludes: notification history that has already been pushed.

The file is password-protected; the same password is required to restore, so keep it safe.

restoreSectionDesc.zh: 选择备份文件并输入口令以恢复。检测到现有配置时，可选择覆盖或仅导入空缺项。
restoreSectionDesc.en: Choose a backup file and enter its password to restore. When existing configuration is detected, you can choose to overwrite or fill gaps only.

restorePick.en: Choose a Backup File to Restore

backupPasswordHint.zh: 口令（至少 8 位；遗失后将无法恢复）
backupPasswordHint.en: Password (at least 8 characters; unrecoverable if lost)

restoreDoneReTest.zh: 恢复完成。含凭据的通道（Webhook/邮件）请重新执行「测试」以验证。
restoreDoneReTest.en: Restore completed. Re-run Test for channels with credentials (Webhook/email) to verify them.

restorePartialFailed.zh: 部分配置未能恢复，请逐项检查设置页
restorePartialFailed.en: Some settings could not be restored; check each settings page

restoreConflictMsg.zh: 当前已存在部分配置。覆盖将替换对应类别的全部内容；仅导入空缺项则保留现有配置不变。
restoreConflictMsg.en: Some configuration already exists. Overwrite replaces all content in the matching categories; Fill gaps leaves existing configuration unchanged.
